project.name: SGQR PayNow Payments
project.description: Singapore QR (SGQR) payments with PayNow: merchants issue dynamic QR codes for a sale, either pre-filled with the amount or for the payer to enter it; payer banking apps pay them through the PayNow gateway over FAST after QR validity, balance, limit and fraud checks; settlement results come back on Kafka and are announced to merchants.

payloads.name: Money
payloads.description: An amount of money in one currency.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The amount, e.g. 4.80

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code

payloads.name: Payer
payloads.description: The person paying, and the account debited.

fields.name: accountId
fields.description: Debit account at the payer bank

payloads.name: Merchant
payloads.description: A merchant registered for SGQR, as returned by merchant-directory.

fields.name: merchantId
fields.description: Acquirer-assigned merchant id

fields.name: name
fields.description: Merchant name shown in the payer app (EMV tag 59, max 25)

fields.name: uen
fields.description: Unique Entity Number; the PayNow proxy the QR pays to

fields.name: city
fields.description: Merchant city (EMV tag 60)

fields.name: mcc
fields.description: Merchant category code (EMV tag 52)

payloads.name: CreateQrCodeRequest
payloads.description: What a merchant terminal sends to get a dynamic PayNow QR for one sale.

fields.name: qrType
fields.description: PREFILLED: the QR carries the amount, the payer only confirms. AMOUNT_ENTRY: the payer types the amount.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Required for PREFILLED; leave out for AMOUNT_ENTRY. PayNow QR is SGD only.

fields.name: billReference
fields.description: Bill or order number shown to the payer (EMV tag 62-01, max 25)

fields.name: expiresInSeconds
fields.description: How long the QR can be paid

payloads.name: EmvPayload
payloads.description: The SGQR string to render as a QR image, from qr-encoder.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: EMVCo merchant-presented QR payload (TLV), PayNow template under tag 26

fields.name: crc
fields.description: CRC-16/CCITT checksum (EMV tag 63)

payloads.name: QrCode
payloads.description: A dynamic QR code issued for one sale.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Empty for AMOUNT_ENTRY QRs

fields.name: amountEditable
fields.description: PayNow "amount editable" flag in the QR; true for AMOUNT_ENTRY

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.description: After this the QR cannot be paid

fields.name: emv
fields.description: Filled in by the encode step

payloads.name: PaymentRequest
payloads.description: What the payer's banking app sends after scanning a QR.

fields.name: qrId
fields.description: From the scanned QR (EMV tag 62-05 reference)

fields.name: amount
fields.description: What the payer typed: required for AMOUNT_ENTRY QRs; leave out (or equal to the QR amount) for PREFILLED

payloads.name: AccountBalance
payloads.description: The payer's account as seen by core-banking.

fields.name: availableBalance
fields.description: Ledger balance minus holds

payloads.name: TransferLimits
payloads.description: The payer's PayNow limits and what has been used today, from limits-service.

fields.name: perTransactionLimit
fields.description: Maximum for one PayNow transfer

fields.name: dailyLimit
fields.description: Maximum total PayNow transfers per day (customer-set)

fields.name: usedToday
fields.description: Total already sent today

payloads.name: FastSubmission
payloads.description: Acknowledgement from the PayNow gateway that the FAST credit transfer was accepted.

fields.name: networkReference
fields.description: FAST end-to-end reference

payloads.name: Payment
payloads.description: A PayNow payment made against a QR code.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Taken from the QR for PREFILLED QRs

fields.name: qr
fields.description: The QR being paid, loaded for the checks

fields.name: reasonCode
fields.description: FAST reject reason, e.g. AC04 (account closed)

payloads.name: PaymentReceipt
payloads.description: What the payer's app gets back: the payment without the balance, limit and risk details used to check it.

payloads.name: SettlementResult
payloads.description: Sent by the PayNow gateway when FAST settles or rejects a transfer.

payloads.name: PaymentInitiatedEvent
payloads.description: Published when a payment has been submitted to FAST.

payloads.name: PaymentCompletedEvent
payloads.description: Published to merchants when a payment settles or is rejected.

payloads.name: PaymentError
payloads.description: Error body returned by every REST endpoint.

endpoints.name: createQrCode
endpoints.summary: Issue a dynamic PayNow QR for a sale
endpoints.description: Checks the request and the merchant, builds the SGQR (EMVCo) payload with the PayNow template and stores the QR.

checks.message: A pre-filled QR needs an amount
Leave the amount empty: the payer enters it

endpoints.name: getQrCode
endpoints.summary: Get a QR code and its status

endpoints.name: initiatePayment
endpoints.summary: Pay a scanned QR with PayNow
endpoints.description: Loads the scanned QR and checks it can still be paid, settles the amount by QR type (pre-filled or payer-entered), checks the balance, the PayNow limits and fraud screening, holds high-value or risky payments for step-up authentication, and submits the FAST credit transfer through the PayNow gateway.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat a request safely; the same key returns the same payment

Core banking or PayNow is unavailable

checks.message: The amount is fixed by this QR; submit it unchanged

endpoints.summary: Get a payment and its status

parameters.name: correlationId

branches.description: mark the payment and the QR paid

endpoints.summary: Payments settled or rejected, for merchants
